label: A two-successor stance with its own universal guarantee norm cannot endorse an exact projection
paraphrase: For every stance admitting both opposite next outcomes, if it endorses its own strong norm requiring exact cross-future prediction and guaranteed payoff two for entitled claims, it must withhold entitlement from every particular scientific forecast and high-payoff practical projection. Endorsing any one such claim while affirming that norm is internally inconsistent. A stance merely denying an ultimate ground, using a safe action or adopting a fallibilist norm is not refuted.
